name: Transfer Status And Reason 09
definition: Information about the status of a transfer instruction and its reason.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual transfers as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual transfers together.

TransferReference.name: Transfer Reference
TransferReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the transfer, as assigned by the instructing party.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of the transfer. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the transfer as assigned by the underlying client.

CancellationReference.name: Cancellation Reference
CancellationReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a transfer cancellation, as assigned by the instructing party.

TransferEventType.name: Transfer Event Type
TransferEventType.definition: Type of event for which the message is sent.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Investment account information of the transfer for which the status or information is provided.

IntermediaryInformation.name: Intermediary Information
IntermediaryInformation.definition: Identification of a related party or intermediary.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Date on which the transfer was executed.|In some scenarios, this is the date and time to be used as the trade date when securities are settled through an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) or Central Securities Depository (CSD).

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date at which the securities are to be exchanged or were exchanged at the International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) or Central Securities Depository (CSD).

SendOutDate.name: Send Out Date
SendOutDate.definition: Date on which the document, for example, the application form, was sent.

CashSettlementDate.name: Cash Settlement Date
CashSettlementDate.definition: Date on which cash is available.

TotalUnitsNumber.name: Total Units Number
TotalUnitsNumber.definition: Number of units to be transferred.

AveragePrice.name: Average Price
AveragePrice.definition: Weighted average price of the units in the account. The average price may also be known as the average acquisition price.

UnitsDetails.name: Units Details
UnitsDetails.definition: Breakdown of units to be transferred.

Conversion.name: Conversion
Conversion.definition: Information about the source security following a conversion.

PaymentDetails.name: Payment Details
PaymentDetails.definition: Details of a payment that will result from or resulting from the liquation of an asset and transfer of cash or for the transfer of cash that was not invested.

BenefitCrystallisationEvent.name: Benefit Crystallisation Event
BenefitCrystallisationEvent.definition: Information about the realisation of benefits taken from a pension.

OtherDrawdownInformation.name: Other Drawdown Information
OtherDrawdownInformation.definition: Drawdown information not specifically associated with a drawdown tranche.

StatusIssuer.name: Status Issuer
StatusIssuer.definition: Party that issues the status or information message.

StatusRecipient.name: Status Recipient
StatusRecipient.definition: Party that receives the status or information message.

TransferStatusEventType1Rule.definition: If at least one occurence of TransferEventType is Information (INFO) then TransferStatus/Status/Status must be equal to Received (RECE).

TransferStatusEventType2Rule.definition: If at least one occurence of TransferEventType is ConversionStatus (CONV) then TransferStatus/Status/Status must be equal to Received (RECE).

ConversionRule.definition: If at least one occurence of TransferEventType is ConversionStatus (CONV) then Conversion must be present.
